title: Environmental Impact Assessment of Natural Resource Projects

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the nature, role, and methods of environmental impact assessment in natural resource projects.
Understand and apply Vietnamese laws and regulations related to environmental impact assessment.
Understand and apply community engagement strategies in environmental impact assessment.
Apply project management principles in the context of environmental impact assessment.
Conduct research and analyze data using appropriate methods for environmental impact assessment.
Analyze and evaluate environmental impacts of natural resource projects.
Effectively communicate findings and recommendations in environmental impact assessment.
Work effectively in teams to solve problems related to environmental impact assessment.
Identify and solve problems using environmental impact assessment methodologies.
Analyze data to assess environmental impacts of natural resource projects.
Write comprehensive reports on environmental impact assessments.
Use GIS for environmental impact assessment.
Apply principles of environmental science in impact assessment.
Understand and apply environmental laws and regulations.
Evaluate projects based on environmental impact assessments.
